root_facts: Temporary mysqldump-shaped artifact bytes, source identity metadata and backup receipt metadata.
Isolated restore adapter outcomes that model artifact mismatch, restored-data mismatch and program-evidence mismatch.
commands: Validate a backup artifact against its source and receipt digest before restore.
Attempt restore into an isolated candidate adapter with corrupted or mismatched data/program evidence.
Inspect partial restore receipts and source/candidate identity guards.
expected: A mismatched or malformed backup stops before restore and cannot claim a valid recovery artifact.
Restored data or program evidence mismatch retains a partial candidate receipt and fails closed instead of overwriting source state.
The harness uses only temporary artifacts and fake isolated adapters; it does not exercise or assert success for a live database restore.
